items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, he was a good musician. Them guys could read.

ctx.x: Yeah, you got killed in Texas.

That's right, yeah. When they play it on the room, Man for Rays and Enesheri make their cladded solo on a cladded. Man for Rays look at Enesheri, and then he's gonna make it on trumpet. Caffer look at it, he's got cladded. Make the cladded. Yeah, them guys could play. That man for Rays was a whip.
Oh yeah, he was a good musician. Them guys could read. All them old time trumpet players like that, man, you had to read, man.
